thread:
Priya: :rotating_light: Escalation from multiple customers in eu-central — seeing a sustained spike in 5xx (502/504) and gateway timeouts for hosted inference since ~08:12 UTC. Customers report partial token streams and repeated retries. Attaching quick repro and two snippets from edge gateway logs below.

Priya: Repro (curl):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=rw-large" -d '{"input":"hi"}' --max-time 10
# intermittent: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

Jenna: Looking at service graphs — request p50 latency up ~3x, error rate concentrated in eu-central az-a and az-b. Traces show upstream reset & TCP retransmits between our edge and transit provider. Packet loss counters elevated on egress-facing NICs around 08:10–08:40.

Mateo: I pulled netflow and BGP state. We saw an upstream AS path change from provider-AS64512 at 08:09 that coincides with the start. Provider corroborated a partial withdrawal on one of their POPs, causing asymmetric routing and increased retransmits.

Alex: Reauth/billing? Customers mention auth retries earlier but current logs show 502 gateway, not 401s. Token validation latencies look normal. Rate limits not tripping.

Tom: Oncall - I've opened a ticket with TransitProvider (case TP-2026-2345). They acknowledged a flapping session to our eu-central egress and are investigating. Case and traceroutes pasted in ticket.

Priya: Customer-facing summary I posted: "We're investigating intermittent gateway errors in eu-central; we suspect upstream provider routing instability. We're routing traffic to fallback endpoints and will post updates every 30m. Apologies for the disruption." :pray:

Mateo: Mitigations applied (at 08:25 UTC):
- Bumped egress path preference to alternate transit (policy id: pref-fallback-ec)
- Enabled cross-region fallback for non-sensitive teams (dev traffic)
- Temporarily increased gateway pool size for eu-central to absorb retries

Mateo: Quick command we used to enable fallback policy (internal infra CLI):
```text
infractl routing set-policy --region eu-central --policy pref-fallback-ec --priority 900
infractl pool scale --pool hosted-eu-central-gw --size +30
```

Jenna: After mitigation, error rate dropped ~60% within 10m but there are still intermittent 502s for some customers (likely pinned routes / private networking). Observability shows reduced retransmits on alternate path.

Clara: CS update: I've notified impacted customers and offered warm standby on Dedicated nodes where possible. One customer requested an incident bridge — arranged at 09:00 UTC.

Alex: Quick note — found a small subset of logs showing 502 + upstream TLS handshake failures. Could be provider-side load shedding. Sharing sample logs to ticket.

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: canary rollback triggered for edge-gateway v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 due to retry storm at 08:35 UTC.

Tom: Action items:
- Mateo to keep provider ticket open and escalate if no ETA by +1h (TP-2026-2345).
- Jenna to monitor p50/p95 and error rate; post snapshots every 15m.
- Alex to check for any auth/billing anomalies tied to retry storms.
- Clara to continue customer comms and coordinate Dedicated migrations for high-severity customers.

Priya: Will draft postmortem stub after stabilization. For now: root cause likely transient BGP/path withdrawal at upstream provider causing cross-zone asymmetric egress + packet loss -> gateway 502s/timeouts. "Next update in 15m". :hourglass_flowing_sand:
